test_cases.name: List CBR vaults via KooCLI (read-only, limit 1)
test_cases.expected: JSON with a vaults list (name/id/billing.status/billing.size/billing.charging_mode) and count

test_cases.name: Vault name list (script, names mode)
test_cases.expected: Header + one '- <name>  (id: <id>, charging_mode: <mode>)' line per vault, or a friendly empty message

test_cases.name: Object-type filter (KooCLI native --object_type)
test_cases.expected: Only vaults whose object_type is 'server' (or a friendly empty message)

test_cases.name: Protection-type filter (KooCLI native --protect_type)
test_cases.expected: Only vaults whose protect_type is 'backup' (or a friendly empty message)

test_cases.name: Vault ID filter (KooCLI native --id.1)
test_cases.expected: Only the vault with the given ID (or a friendly empty message)

test_cases.name: Enterprise project filter (KooCLI native --enterprise_project_id)
test_cases.expected: Only vaults in the given enterprise project (or a friendly empty message)

notes: 只读操作（CBR ListVault），无资源创建/修改/删除风险。CLI 路径使用 hcloud CBR ListVault（单数；ListVaults 不被支持）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkcbr v1 CbrClient.list_vault。名称/状态/对象类型/保护类型/企业项目/存储库 ID 过滤为 ListVault 原生查询参数（KooCLI 下划线形态 --object_type/--protect_type/--enterprise_project_id；vault ID 用数组形态 --id.1=），脚本同时做客户端复核过滤。vault_id 为示例值，可替换为真实存储库 ID。读取成功需要账号具备 cbr:vaults:list 权限。
